game: Gobble Dash — The Great Turkey Escape

shots.caption: Title screen: Gobble Dash, the turkey, the farm at dusk, controls and start prompt.
Mid-run: the turkey sprinting past a hay bale and the oven, corn arc overhead, the farmer closing in, HUD with score, distance, hearts and progress bar.
Caught end screen: the farmer got the turkey, score and distance of the run, restart prompt.
Escaped end screen: the turkey reached the forest gate at 1500 m, score and restart prompt.
